info.name: EN - Big Shot (2021)
info.director: Brad Garrett, David E. Kelley, Dean Lorey

info.plot: After getting ousted from his job in the NCAA for throwing a chair at a referee, a hothead men’s basketball coach Marvyn Korn must take a job at Westbrook School for Girls, a private all-girls high school, in an effort to redeem what's left of his career and reputation.
